messages:
Jamie H: Hey @people-ops — starting parental leave in ~6 weeks. Quick Q: can I delegate filing the actual paperwork to my manager or do I need to submit everything myself? Also planning a staggered return (4 weeks total, half-time first 2 weeks). How do we record that? Need to arrange a short handoff for on-call coverage. Thanks!

Sofia P (People Ops): Congrats, Jamie! :tada: You should complete the parental leave form in the Leave Portal and attach any supporting docs (medical or FMLA where applicable). Your manager can gather materials and help with the handover, but the formal submission/signature needs to come from you (digital). For a staggered/phased return, choose the "Phased Return" option in the portal and specify weekly hours. Link: https://redwood-internal/hr/leave-guides/parental

Alex R: I can own equipment signoff and on-call coverage while you're out. Jamie — can you paste a short handover bullet list and I'll slot folks in?

Jamie H: Thanks Alex. One follow-up — payroll for the partial return, is that automatically pro-rated or do I need to file anything separate?

Sofia P (People Ops): Payroll pro-rates based on the phased return entry. When you set 'Phased Return' you pick either "partial weekly hours" or "reduced FTE"; payroll and benefits will follow that selection. No extra payroll form needed, but please confirm dates so we can update the payrun. I'll DM the exact portal flow.

HR Bot: Uploaded: parental-leave-checklist.pdf — https://redwood-internal/storage/parental-leave-checklist.pdf

Jamie H: Appreciate it. One more: we'll be traveling internationally for ~3 weeks during the leave window. Any additional paperwork or tax implications I should flag?

Sofia P (People Ops): If you're traveling, please notify people-ops with travel dates and a contact plan. Travel doesn't change leave entitlements, but we need to confirm availability expectations (e.g., emergency contactability) and ensure payroll address/tax withholding are correct if you change residence. We'll escalate to payroll if there's anything region-specific.

Alex R: For on-call coverage, I'll pair Priya and Luis for the first two weeks and add a rotation to the team's calendar. Jamie, paste the runbook bullets and I'll tag owners.

Jamie H: OK here's the handover draft:
```
Handover:
- On-call rotation: Priya/Luis cover weeks 1-2, escalate to SRE pager 1 if CI alert persists
- Open PRs: #432 (query optimizer) & #436 (deploy script) — reviewers assigned: @Priya, @Luis
- Scheduled demos: 2026-04-12 09:00 PT (notify PMs)
- Recurring weekly sync: pause during leave; please loop in Alex for blockers
- Laptop/equipment: leave with Alex R for secure storage; Alex to confirm signout on return
- Emergency contact: jamie.cell@example.com
```

Sofia P (People Ops): Perfect, I'll confirm the portal entries and set a calendar reminder for you to complete the formal submission 2 weeks before leave starts. Also adding a checklist for international travel to the doc. :white_check_mark:

Alex R: Sounds good — I'll update the runbook and post a short note in eng-oncall. :thumbsup:

Jamie H: Thanks everyone, that helps a lot. I'll post any updates here as I finalize dates.
